candidates.name: Sahithi Regalla
candidates.headline: Hands-on UKG Ready in a multi-client payroll seat — the closest match on the systems and the operating model.
candidates.intro: Sahithi has eight years across payroll, HR operations and accounting, with the last three in US payroll. The part that matters for this seat sits in the middle of her history: at Red Leaf IT Systems she ran payroll administration in UKG Ready and produced multi-client payroll and year-end reporting, and before that she spent two years inside an HR Shared Services model at Harsco's global service centre — payroll audits, reconciliations, year-end, and employee lifecycle transactions alongside HR business partners. She is currently at Baltimore Police Department handling bi-weekly payroll, timekeeping and FLSA compliance in Workday, and is a Certified Payroll Professional candidate for 2026.
fitBullets: Actual UKG Ready, not an adjacent product — used for payroll processing, W-2 and 1099 work and data validation at Red Leaf. This is the platform Procare named.
Multi-client payroll experience — generated multi-client payroll and year-end reporting from HRIS data, and worked payroll disputes for worksite employees.

Shared-services operating model — two years inside an HR Shared Services centre running payroll audits, reconciliations, year-end activity and employee lifecycle transactions alongside HR business partners.

Owns the client relationship under pressure. On a missing-overtime dispute she validated the data, identified a client transmission error, walked the client through the correction, ran an emergency off-cycle batch with same-day deposits, then built an automated validation checklist so it could not recur.
Current on compliance and credentials — FLSA-compliant timekeeping, garnishments under federal and state rules, multi-state payroll, and a Certified Payroll Professional candidate for 2026.
Authorised to work in the US without employer sponsorship.
candidates.cta: The systems and the operating model line up here better than anywhere else we have looked — UKG Ready, multi-client payroll and real client ownership in one candidate. Worth a first conversation.

candidates.name: Candle Meyers
candidates.headline: Twenty-five years of high-volume, multi-state payroll — and the systems range to pick up anything you put in front of her.
candidates.intro: Candle has run payroll at a scale this role will never quite reach: 1,400+ employees across seven states weekly at Dreamfields, 1,000+ across multiple states plus Canada and Mexico at Revere, 1,200+ across five states at Epic Fitness. Across that she has owned the whole cycle — timekeeping validation, audits and reconciliations, garnishments, bonuses and commissions, multi-jurisdiction tax compliance, and the employee and manager inquiries that come with it. Her systems range is unusually wide: ADP Workforce Now, Paycom, Paycor, Paylocity, Paychex, isolved, Kronos, SmartLinx, Workday, PeopleSoft. She has also led the function, not just run it — Director of HR, Payroll and Business Operations for three years, with AP/AR and a team under her.
fitBullets: Volume and jurisdiction complexity well beyond this seat — weekly payroll for 1,400+ across seven states, plus international payroll spanning the US, Canada and Mexico.
Genuinely platform-agnostic — twelve-plus payroll and HRIS systems in production use, including isolved, Paycom, Paylocity and Kronos, which are the closest neighbours to UKG Ready.

Has owned the relationship, not just the processing — Director-level ownership of HR, payroll and business operations, regular vendor partnership calls, and named point of contact for payroll and benefits questions.
Audit-first discipline — payroll audits, reconciliations and quality-control reviews as standing practice, and she adds a control step after resolving an issue so it cannot recur.
Exceeds the education preference — MBA in Human Resource Management against an Associate's 'nice to have'.
candidates.cta: Twenty-five years of payroll at scale, with the seniority to own a book of clients from day one. Worth a first conversation.

candidates.name: Bhargavi Ramasagaram
candidates.company: University of South Florida (contract via Robert Half)
candidates.workAuth: L2-EAD — valid US work authorisation, no sponsorship required
candidates.headline: Nine corporate EINs run at once, a 16,000-employee payroll, and $1.2M in overpayments recovered.
candidates.intro: Bhargavi has nine years in payroll and payroll accounting, most of it multi-state and multi-entity. She is currently at the University of South Florida on a Robert Half contract, running full-cycle payroll for 16,000+ faculty, staff and student employees in ADP Workforce Now and Oracle HR, where she recovered $1,206,506 in salary overpayments in ten months by building a tracking system, standard notification letters and automated paycheck adjustments. Before that she ran multi-state payroll at Alltech and at Hughes Systique across six jurisdictions, and spent over two years as payroll consultant to AGES Learning Solutions covering 450+ employees in five states. She is a Chartered Accountant (Inter) with a B.Com in Taxation and ADP Learning Academy certifications.
fitBullets: Multi-EIN depth, which is the rarest filter on this search — she describes running end-to-end payroll across 9 distinct corporate EINs and 1,200+ multi-state employees at once, using staggered pay-period cutoffs, automated bulk tax deposits and cross-entity reconciliation before funding.

PEO / shared-services model — she reports working across multiple independent client companies with their own policies, benefits and multi-state tax structures, to client SLAs rather than a single company's internal calendar.

Volume and jurisdiction complexity — 16,000+ employees at USF today; earlier multi-state payroll across Maryland, New Jersey, New York, Pennsylvania, Tennessee and Bangalore, plus California and Utah at AGES.

Compliance range beyond standard payroll — non-resident alien tax and Form 1042-S treaty reporting, court-ordered garnishments, tax levies, FRS/ORP retirement contributions, W-2/W-2c and 1099, and year-end prior-year overpayment logic.

Client-facing under pressure. On an ADP-to-Oracle migration, a configuration mapping error overpaid a group of employees. She audited the period, quantified the amounts, worked with legal and HR against state wage-repayment law, contacted the affected employees and client stakeholders with repayment options and a direct contact line, recovered 95% of the funds without a grievance, and corrected the Oracle setup.

Systems: ADP Workforce Now, ADP GlobalView, ADP SmartCompliance, Oracle HCM, PeopleSoft, UKG Ready, QuickBooks, Central Reach, Jira Service Management. She describes her UKG Ready use as configuring pay rules, multi-state tax compliance, time and attendance workflows, multi-entity processing, custom reporting and open enrolment.
candidates.cta: The multi-EIN and multi-state record here is the closest match to the must-haves we have seen, she is authorised to work without sponsorship, and she can start on two weeks’ notice.
